_comment: Fare tables used by the planner. Every class carries a confidence: 'official' (published LTFRB/LRMC figure), 'reported' (from news coverage of the official order - verify), or 'estimate' (PUBTA's assumption; fares vary). Change a number here and the planner uses it immediately - no code changes needed.

puj_traditional.label: Traditional jeepney
puj_traditional.source: LTFRB fare adjustment, effective 2026-09-28 (PHP 14 first 4 km, +PHP 2.00/km). https://philstarlife.com/news-and-views/486689-dotr-approves-puv-fare-hikes-effective-sept-28

puj_modern.label: Modern jeepney
puj_modern.source: LTFRB fare adjustment, effective 2026-09-28 (PHP 17 first 4 km, +PHP 2.40/km). https://mb.com.ph/2026/03/17/ltfrb-approves-balanced-fare-hikes-for-jeepneys-other-puvs

bus_ordinary.label: City bus (ordinary)
bus_ordinary.source: LTFRB 2026 adjustment for Metro Manila ordinary buses (PHP 15 first 5 km, +PHP 2.49/km as reported).

bus_aircon.label: City bus (air-conditioned)
bus_aircon.source: LTFRB 2026 adjustment for Metro Manila aircon buses (PHP 18 first 5 km, +PHP 2.98/km as reported).

uv_express.label: UV Express
uv_express.source: PUBTA estimate - UV Express fares vary by route; check the posted fare matrix at the terminal.

free.label: Free ride
free.source: QCityBus is a free city bus service.

lrt1.label: LRT-1
lrt1.source: LRMC single-journey fare matrix, effective 2025-04-02: PHP 20 minimum, PHP 55 maximum end-to-end. Per-station values are interpolated here - check lrmc.ph for the exact matrix.

mrt3.label: MRT-3
mrt3.source: PUBTA estimate from the published MRT-3 range.

lrt2.label: LRT-2
lrt2.source: PUBTA estimate from the published LRT-2 range.

tricycle.label: Tricycle

Valenzuela.source: Valenzuela City TODA fare, reduced to PHP 10 + PHP 1.50/km (2023 report). May have changed - ask the driver.

Malabon.source: Malabon fare matrix (2020 report): PHP 15 within 1 km, +PHP 2 per km.

Caloocan.source: PUBTA estimate - no current published Caloocan matrix found.

Navotas.source: PUBTA estimate - no current published Navotas matrix found.

tricycle.note: Tricycle fares are set per city and per TODA, and are often negotiated. 'Special trips' (the whole tricycle for yourself) cost several times more.

discounts._comment: Share of the fare that is waived for the passenger type. Students (RA 11314), senior citizens (RA 9994) and persons with disability (RA 7277) get 20% on road transport. The 50% train concession is as reported for LRT-1 (white Beep card) - verify at the station.
